name: Kim Do-hyun
bio: Kim Do-hyun, known as Doha, is a lead vocalist of the K-pop boy group MustB (reformed as BE:MAX). Debuting in 2019, he is celebrated for his emotional live vocals and striking visuals. In 2024, he and his team expanded their global presence by competing on the reality survival show "Re:BORN".
